name: 2030 GeoSim
description: Open-source Complex Adaptive Systems engine for geopolitical risk, Monte Carlo war-gaming, nuclear deterrence, and chokepoint analysis. Public JSON API, no auth, CORS-open.

capabilities.name: world_state
capabilities.description: Current baseline actors, tensions, chokepoint status.

capabilities.name: simulate
capabilities.description: Run a single forward simulation of a named scenario.

capabilities.name: monte_carlo
capabilities.description: Run N ensemble runs; returns distribution and composite risk.

capabilities.name: belief_fusion
capabilities.description: Fuse multi-actor beliefs and evolve strategies.

capabilities.name: parse_natural_language
capabilities.description: Parse a natural-language command into a structured scenario call.
